name: Ferruginous-Dirge
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past geothermal vent fields, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Established during the last boom, the pirate hideout was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
